derivation.description: At zero equivalents, the frozen 0.1000 mol/L HCl stock has one analytical HCl mole per litre and water mass ρ − cM. The strong-acid limiting ionic strength is therefore c/(ρ − cM). The production activity solve may differ only by the explicitly bounded water-autoprotolysis correction.
derivation.independence: This acceptance output is intentionally separate from the scientific-input manifest. Updating frozen inputs requires an explicit reference review and input-manifest digest update; it must not silently retune the expected envelope result.
